name: Maybe Valentine's Day isn't the Worst
source:
This is the story of Jim and Oscar. Jim is a workaholic hopelessly in love with his older, straight, former strongman, married boss. And Oscar, well, he's that boss. They've worked side by side for years and become very close friends during that time. However, their friendship will be tested when the two must take a business trip together with emotions running high, and surprising developments unfolding! Valentine's Day looms on the horizon, a holiday that Jim notoriously despises. Could there be any chance that something special might occur between the two of them? It seems unlikely but, crazier things have happened! 

[From [url=https://dudebulge.itch.io/maybe-valentines-day-isnt-the-worst]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是吉姆和奥斯卡的故事。吉姆是一个工作狂，无可救药地爱上了他年长、异性恋、前强人、已婚的老板。奥斯卡，好吧，他就是那个老板。他们并肩工作多年，并在那段时间成为非常亲密的朋友。然而，当两人必须一起出差，情绪高涨，意外的事态展开时，他们的友谊将受到考验！情人节即将来临，这是吉姆众所周知的鄙视节日。难道他们两个之间会发生什么特别的事情吗？这似乎不太可能，但更疯狂的事情发生了！

[来自[url=https://dudebulge.itch.io/maybe-valentines-day-isnt-the-worst]itch.io[/url]]
